card.name: The word of after history
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "history" in contraindication lists, such as "history of hypersensitivity to". Also weaker on "with" or "Following" in similar condition phrases.

modes.label: History of
modes.description: The word "of" after "history" introducing a prior reaction or disease in a contraindication.
modes.example: Gatifloxacin ophthalmic solution is contraindicated in patients with a history<< of>> hypersensitivity to gatifloxacin,

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: "with" or "Following" linking a patient group or heading to a condition.
modes.example: and in patients<< with>> hereditary or idiopathic angioed

card.plain: It fires on the "of" in "history of" when a label lists conditions, like allergy or liver disease, that rule out use.
